allowed: salted SHA-256 commitments to repository identity, immutable revision, family, semantic domain, and license identity
encryption algorithm, nonce, and authentication-tag encodings
curator public-key fingerprint and detached manifest signature
forbidden: model, operator, architecture, graph, shape, fixture, or expected-output details
candidate, fixed, or control match results

cryptographic_policy.manifest_canonicalization: UTF-8 RFC8259 JSON sorted keys compact separators plus one LF
cryptographic_policy.payload_digest: payload.v7.sha256 contains lowercase SHA-256, two spaces, payload.v7.enc, and LF
cryptographic_policy.public_key: PEM SubjectPublicKeyInfo RSA at least 3072 bits
cryptographic_policy.signature: RSA-PSS SHA-256 detached signature verified by OpenSSL 3

decision_rule.complete: all five files exist and both validators agree on every schema, commitment, signature, key, payload, entropy, and forbidden-file check
decision_rule.complete_next_action: freeze the exact opaque bundle and separately verify independent curator provenance before constructing an authorization overlay
decision_rule.invalid: any present artifact violates the contract, a forbidden key or plaintext-like file exists, validators disagree, or signature/payload authentication fails
decision_rule.invalid_next_action: quarantine the bundle without decrypting it and preserve the rejection receipt
decision_rule.waiting: one or more required files are absent and no unrecognized or forbidden sensitive file is present
decision_rule.waiting_next_action: retain the empty identity-only inbox and await an externally curated signed encrypted bundle
